how_to_update: Hand-kept. Referee assignments are published during the week (Football Zebras usually posts them by Thursday). Add the week under 'weeks' as {"<nflverse game_id>": "Referee Name"}, using the name as nflverse schedules spell it, and set source.url, source.title and source.retrieved. Leave a week out until it is published: the report then shows 'assignment not loaded'.
